# Olympus-Grid (πλέγμα-Όλυμπος™)
# https://www.olympus-grid.com

> The globally sustainable, enterprise certified, off-grid capable AI infrastructure platform.

Olympus-Grid is a sovereign enterprise AI infrastructure platform. It enables organizations to run AI applications on a 31-agent mesh called Olympus-616 — deployed on Salesforce + AWS, hybrid cloud, or fully off-grid on local hardware.

## Key Concepts

- **Olympus-Grid**: The infrastructure layer. Certified on the Salesforce AppExchange. Provides Identity, Metering, Ledger, Agent Mesh, and Tenant isolation.
- **Olympus-616**: The primary sovereign AI instance — a 31-agent mesh named for the Greek pantheon. Any organization can deploy their own instance.
- **TurtleShell.ai**: The flagship application built on Olympus-Grid, proving the platform can scale a consumer AI product across iOS, web, and Salesforce.
- **Cosmos-Logos**: Open-source agent discovery and verification protocol. Ed25519 sealed-envelope identity handshake.

## Agents (Pantheon)

Athena (LLM Router), Poseidon (MCP Tools), Hermes (API Gateway), Iris (Portal Framework), Oracle (Identity Provider), Proteus (ORM), Plutus (General Ledger / Metering), Ares (Security Gateway), Apollo (Text-to-Speech), Mnemosyne (Memory), Zeus (Infrastructure / CDK), and 20+ additional sovereign services.

## Deployment Models

1. Salesforce managed package + AWS Fargate container fleet
2. Hybrid cloud with existing AWS infrastructure
3. Fully off-grid on Mac Mini or Raspberry Pi 5 nodes
4. Azure and GCP available upon request

## Identity & Authentication

Apple Sign In, Google, Microsoft, Email magic-link. Identity__c on Salesforce is the canonical anchor. httpOnly cookies, JWT verification, zero standing access to customer data.

## Billing & Metering

Fully metered platform — every LLM turn, tool call, memory operation, and API request is tracked and auditable. Stripe, Apple IAP, and Google Play billing integrations. 7% Olympus Foundation tithe on all transactions.

## Data Sovereignty

Your data lives in your Salesforce org and your AWS account. CloudPremise operates the software layer — never the data layer. SOC 2 Type II certification in progress.
